head_commit.message:
fix(linux-sandbox): mount /dev in bwrap sandbox (#12081)

## Summary
- Updates the Linux bubblewrap sandbox args to mount a minimal `/dev`
using `--dev /dev` instead of only binding `/dev/null`. tools needing
entropy (git, crypto libs, etc.) can fail.

- Changed mount order so `--dev /dev` is added before writable-root
`--bind` mounts, preserving writable `/dev/*` submounts like `/dev/shm`

## Why
Fixes sandboxed command failures when reading `/dev/urandom` (and
similar standard device-node access).


Fixes https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/12056

head_commit.message:
docs(mcp): document how to pass environment variables to MCP servers

Closes #7521.

Users frequently ask how to pass API keys and secrets to MCP server
processes. This commit adds a dedicated section under "Connecting to
MCP servers" that explains:

- Arguments in  are passed literally (no shell expansion)
- Two correct approaches: static value in
  table, or inheriting from host via  list
- Warning about  potentially blocking
  variable forwarding (with a reference to #3064)
